content.zekr: I seek refuge in God from Satan, the accursed. 'There is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting. No year overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is there that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they do not comprehend any of His knowledge except by what He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not prevent Him from preventing Him. He is the Most High, the Great.' - Ayat Al-Kursi, Al-Baqarah ,255.
content.bless: Whoever says it in the morning will be protected from the jinn until the evening, and whoever says it in the evening will be protected from the jinn until the morning.

content.zekr: I seek refuge in God from Satan, the accursed. The Messenger believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. Everyone believes in God and His angels and His books. And His Messengers, We make no distinction between any of His Messengers. And they said, We hear and obey. Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the return. God does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear. It is for it what it has earned and upon it is what it has earned. Our Lord, do not hold us accountable if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, nor Lay upon us a burden just as You laid upon those before us, our Lord, and do not burden us with what we have no strength to bear, but pardon us and forgive us and have mercy on us. Our Master, so help us against the disbelieving people. [Al-Baqarah 285 - 286].
content.bless: Whoever recites two verses from the end of Surat Al-Baqarah in one night, it is sufficient for him.

content.zekr: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say, “He is God, One, God, the Eternal, He begot neither, nor was He begotten, and there is no one equal to Him.
content.bless: Whoever says it in the morning and in the evening is sufficient for everything (Al-Ikhlas and Al-Mu'awwidhatain).

content.zekr: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say, “I seek refuge in the Lord of creation, from the evil of what He created, and from the evil of darkness when it approaches, and from the evil of blowing on the knot, and from the evil of Envious when he envies.
content.bless: Whoever says it in the morning and in the evening is sufficient for everything (Al-Ikhlas and Al-Mu'awwidhatain).

content.zekr: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say, “I seek refuge in the Lord of the people, the King of the people, the God of the people, from the evil of the deceitful whisperer, the one who whispers In people's chests, from heaven and people.
content.bless: Whoever says it in the morning and in the evening is sufficient for everything (Al-Ikhlas and Al-Mu'awwidhatain).

content.zekr: This evening and tomorrow belongs to God, and praise be to God. There is no god but God alone, with no partner. To Him belongs dominion and to Him is praise, and He is capable of all things. My Lord, I ask you for the best of this day and the best of after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and evil arrogance. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the torment of Hell and torment in the grave.

Oh God, You are my Lord, there is no god but You, You created me and I am Your servant, and I adhere to Your covenant and promise as much as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessing upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for no one forgives sins except You.
content.bless: Whoever says it with certainty in the evening and dies that night will enter Paradise, and the same will happen in the morning.

content.zekr: I am satisfied with God as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, as my Prophet.
content.bless: Whoever says it in the morning and in the evening, God has a right to please him on the Day of Resurrection.

content.zekr: Oh God, in the evening I bear witness to You, and I bear witness to the bearers of Your throne, and to Your angels, and to all of Your creation, that You are God, there is no god but You alone. Your partner, and Muhammad is your servant and Messenger.
content.bless: Whoever says it, God will free him from Hell.

content.zekr: Oh God, whatever blessing has befallen me or one of your creation, it is from you alone, with no partner, so to you is praise and thanks to you.
content.bless: Whoever says it in the morning has fulfilled his day’s gratitude.

content.zekr: God is sufficient for me, there is no god but Him, in Him I put my trust, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.
content.bless: Whoever says it, may God protect him from what concerns him about the affairs of this world and the hereafter.

content.zekr: In the name of God, with whose name nothing can be harmed on earth or in heaven, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
Oh God, by you we have entered the evening and by you we have become in the morning, by you we live and by you we die, and to you is the resurrection.

We spent the evening following the nature of Islam, the word sincerity, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and the religion of our father Abraham, upright and Muslim. He was one of the polytheists.
Glory be to God, and praise be to Him according to the number of His creation, the satisfaction of Himself, the weight of His Throne, and the ink of His words.
Oh God, grant me health in my body, O God, grant me health in my hearing, O God, grant me health in my sight, there is no god but You.
Oh God, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the torment of the grave. There is no god but You.

Oh God, I ask you for forgiveness and well-being in this world and the hereafter, O God, I ask you for forgiveness and well-being in my religion, my world, my family and my money, Oh God, cover my private parts and secure my splendor. Oh God, protect me from before me and behind me, from my right and from my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in By your greatness lest I be assassinated from under me.
O Ever-Living, O Ever-Living, by Your mercy I seek help. Reconcile all my affairs for me and do not leave me to myself for the blink of an eye.

Our evening and the evening of the kingdom belongs to God, Lord of the worlds. Oh God, I ask you for the goodness of this day, its conquest, its victory, its light and its blessing. And guide it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of what is in it and the evil of what comes after it.

Oh God, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord of everything and its Sovereign, I bear witness that there is no god but You, I seek refuge in You from the evil of Myself and from the evil of Satan and his polytheism, and that I commit evil upon myself or turn it into a Muslim.
I seek refuge in the perfect words of God from the evil of what He created.

O God, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed the family of Abraham. You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. O God, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed the family of Muhammad. Abraham, you are Praiseworthy and Glorious.
content.bless: Whoever prays in the morning and in the evening, My intercession will reach him on the Day of Resurrection.

content.zekr: Oh God, we seek refuge in You from associating with You anything we know, and we seek Your forgiveness for what we do not know.

Oh God, I seek refuge in You from worry and sadness, I seek refuge in You from inability and laziness, I seek refuge in You from cowardice and miserliness, I seek refuge in You From the dominance of debt, and the oppression of men.
I ask forgiveness from God Almighty, there is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the Eternal, and I repent to Him.
O Lord, praise be to You as it befits the majesty of Your face and the greatness of Your power.

Oh God, You are my Lord, there is no god but You, I put my trust in You, and You are the Lord of the Great Throne. Whatever God wills, it happens, and what He does not will, it does not happen, nor does it happen. There is no power nor strength except with God, the Most High, the Great. I know that God has power over all things, and that God encompasses all things in knowledge. Oh God, I I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself, and from the evil of every living creature whose corner you seize. Indeed, my Lord is on a straight path.
There is no god but God alone, with no partner. To Him belongs dominion and to Him is praise, and He is capable of all things.
content.bless: He had the equivalent of ten slaves, a hundred good deeds were recorded for him, a hundred bad deeds were erased from him, and it was a protection for him from Satan.

content.zekr: Glory be to God and praise be to Him.
content.bless: His sins were removed, even if they were like the foam of the sea. No one will come on the Day of Resurrection with something better than what he brought, except someone who said the same as what he said or added to it.
